set(AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fixtures-audio)

# Synthetic audio for the tests, regenerated by ctest before tests that need it.
add_test(NAME make_fixtures COMMAND ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/make-fixtures.sh ${AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES})
set_tests_properties(make_fixtures PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP audio_fixtures)

function(audium_add_test name)
    add_executable(${name} ${name}.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(${name} PRIVATE
        AUDIUM_VERSION_STRING="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
        AUDIUM_FIXTURES_DIR="${AUDIUM_TEST_FIXTURES}")
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE Qt::Test audium_ui audium_uiplugin)
    add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
    set_tests_properties(${name} PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")
endfunction()

find_package(Qt6 ${QT_MIN_VERSION} REQUIRED COMPONENTS Sql)

audium_add_test(test_bridge)
audium_add_test(test_playback)
audium_add_test(test_session)
target_link_libraries(test_session PRIVATE Qt::Sql)
set_tests_properties(test_bridge test_playback test_session PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED audio_fixtures TIMEOUT 180)
